theorem_title: Pruned encoding exponent is bounded by the original encoding exponent
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSumSharpTail.pruned_encoding_comparison (c : ℝ) (hc : 1 < c) :
    ((c / 2) * ThreeSumSharpTail.entropy (1 / c) + (c - 1) * Real.log 3) / Real.log 4
      ≤ ThreeSumSharpTail.encodingExponent c := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every real c>1, the exponent ((c/2)H(1/c)+(c-1)log(3))/log(4) is at most A(c). Consequently the strict thinness assumption in the sharp-tail certificate also satisfies the encoding assumption of the parameterized pruned program interface. This comparison follows from the weighted log inequality H(p)+(1-p)log(9)<=log(10).
